title: sig'stable(T ns) time-argument fence — Tier 4.1 close-out
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Gates `stable_out` on `data'stable(20 ns)` inside a clocked process. Pre-close-out, Operation.TryConsumeStableTimeArg pre-scaled ns*1000 assuming 1 ns per tick; SignalScheduler defaults to 10 ns/tick, so the internal comparison was off by 10×. The Tier 4.1 close-out moves the scaling into SignalAttributeHandler.GetStable(sig, ns) using the engine's registered TickResolutionNs. With tickResNs=1 in this case the fix is a no-op numerically but the same code path is exercised.
